component.name: PiliPlus
component.summary: Third-party Bilibili client developed in Flutter

description.p: This is a community package of PiliPlus, maintained independently and unaffiliated with upstream. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.
PiliPlus is a cross-platform Bilibili client developed with Flutter, providing a clean and feature-rich viewing experience.

ul.li: Browse and watch videos, anime, live streams, and dynamic feeds.
Video playback powered by mpv and media_kit.
Support for user login, history, favorites, and watch later.
Dark mode and customizable UI themes.

description.p: Permissions: this package grants display, GPU acceleration, audio playback (PulseAudio/PipeWire), network access for streaming and API requests, desktop notifications, and the StatusNotifier tray. Settings and cache files stay inside the sandbox under ~/.var/app/com.example.piliplus. No host filesystem access is granted by default.

ul.li: Save downloaded videos to your Downloads directory: flatpak override --user --filesystem=xdg-download com.example.piliplus
